description: Send the Helix team feedback about these tools: a bug, a missing capability or a confusing result. Use it when a tool fails in a way you can't work around, or can't do what the task needs. At most 20 an hour.

category.description: What kind of feedback it is.

message.description: What happened or what you needed, up to 4096 bytes. Say what you tried and what you expected; leave out secrets and customer data.

tool.description: The Helix tool it is about, if any.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it is about, if any; a service key's own workspace when empty.

name: helix_feedback
title: Send feedback to Helix
